title: Vendor Analytics — Generate / Export Report
description: Powers the Export report drawer. Every report uses the same body: report, start_date, end_date, format. Year/month chips on Order fulfilment are UI-only and resolve to those dates before the request is sent.

endpoint.auth: Vendor Bearer token + Application-Token (same as other /api/vendor/* routes)

request_body.report: Required. One of: summary | sales_by_category | customer_growth | sales_by_region | top_products | order_fulfillment
request_body.end_date: YYYY-MM-DD. Required. Inclusive end. Must be on or after start_date.
request_body.format: csv. Required. Only CSV is supported in this version.

fulfillment_ui_to_dates.note: Frontend converts the selected calendar chip into start_date and end_date. Backend only receives the shared payload above.
